initialExam.title: Bihar Judicial Services 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment of Civil Judges (Junior Division) in Bihar through Bihar Judicial Service Competitive Examination conducted under the supervision of the Patna High Court.
initialExam.eligibility: LLB from recognized university + enrolled advocate
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: Civil Law (CPC, Contract Act, TPA, Specific Relief Act, Limitation Act, Hindu Law, Muslim Law), Criminal Law (IPC, CrPC, Indian Evidence Act, NDPS Act, Prevention of Corruption Act), Constitutional & Administrative Law (Fundamental Rights, Writs, Judicial Review, PIL), Revenue & Local Laws (Bihar Land Reforms Act, Bihar Tenancy Act, Bihar Panchayat Raj Act), General English & Hindi.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims (Objective): Civil + Criminal + Constitutional Law + GK - 100 marks, 120 min. Mains: Paper I (English & GK) 100 marks, Paper II (Civil Law) 100 marks, Paper III (Criminal Law) 100 marks, Paper IV (Constitutional & Revenue Law) 100 marks - 180 min each. Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Preliminary Examination → Mains Examination → Interview/Viva Voce → Document Verification → Medical Examination

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: BC/EBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years, Female: 3 years

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, Official Residence, Conveyance Allowance, Book Allowance
initialExam.careerGrowth: Civil Judge JD → Civil Judge SD → Additional District Judge → District & Sessions Judge → High Court elevation.
initialExam.jobRole: Presiding over civil suits and criminal cases in Bihar subordinate courts. Conducting hearings, framing charges, recording evidence, and pronouncing judgments.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit patnahighcourt.gov.in 2. Go to Recruitment 3. Register 4. Fill application 5. Upload documents 6. Pay fee 7. Submit
